issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not mention 'Đức Giê-hô-va' (the LORD) as the subject; the subject is the child ('đứa trẻ') who will carry away the wealth. The Vietnamese adds 'Đức Giê-hô-va sẽ đem lấy' (the LORD will take away), which introduces an agent not present in the Hebrew and changes who performs the action.
